name: vscode-llm-mobile-bridge
description: A privacy-first mobile view of local Claude Code and Codex sessions.

commands.title: LLM Mobile Bridge: Copy Pairing Payload
LLM Mobile Bridge: Disconnect All Devices

llmMobileBridge.autoStart.description: Start the loopback gateway automatically in trusted workspaces.

llmMobileBridge.port.description: Loopback WebSocket port used by the development gateway.

llmMobileBridge.mobileUrl.description: URL copied to Android. The default reaches Windows localhost from an emulator.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/json-rpc-client.test.js dist/test/session-registry.test.js dist/test/gateway-core.test.js dist/test/claude-adapter.test.js dist/test/codex-adapter.test.js dist/test/local-gateway-server.test.js
scripts.probe: npm run build && node dist/index.js probe
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npm run bundle:extension && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out artifacts/llm-mobile-bridge.vsix
